privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.html:
Last updated: 21 November 2026

Dobie Dash is a game made by Dan Horne ("I", "me"). This policy explains what the game collects, why, and what you can do about it. I've kept it short and plain.

The short version

  • You don't need an account to play, and I never ask for your name.
  • Your progress is saved on your phone and in your own iCloud.
  • The leaderboards know your dog's name, how it looks and your scores, under an anonymous ID.
  • Ads come from Google AdMob. They're only personalised if you say yes when iPhone asks about tracking.
  • I use Google Firebase to count how the game is played and to find crashes.
  • I never sell your data.

What's collected, and why

Your game save. Biscuits, items, missions and settings are stored on your phone and in your iCloud account (through Apple), so they move with you to a new phone. I can't see them.

Leaderboards. When you play online the game creates an anonymous player ID on my server (Supabase). It stores your dog's name and look, your scores and the taps of each scored run (so the server can replay the run and check it's real), your league, friends you add by code, and any names you report. Other players see your dog's name, look and scores.

Keep your place (optional). If you choose to Sign in with Apple, Apple tells my server a user ID and an email address (which can be Apple's private relay address). It's used only to give you the same place on the boards on another phone. I don't email you.

Purchases. Apple handles all payments. RevenueCat (my purchase server) receives an anonymous ID and what you bought, so purchases can be restored. I never see your card or Apple ID.

Ads. Google AdMob shows ads. It may collect your device's advertising ID (only if you allow tracking), approximate location from your IP address, and how you interact with ads, to show and measure ads. See Google's policy: https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

Analytics and crashes. Google Firebase Analytics records game events such as a run finishing or a world reached, with an app-instance ID, and Firebase Crashlytics sends crash reports. These help me balance the game and fix bugs. They don't include your name.

Game Center. Achievements go through Apple's Game Center under your Game Center account.

Feedback. If you use Send feedback, you email me directly and I'll only use it to reply.

Tracking

The first time an ad is about to show, iPhone asks whether Dobie Dash may track you. If you say no, ads still show but aren't personalised, and no advertising ID is shared. You can change this any time in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking.

Children

Dobie Dash is rated 4+ but isn't made for children under 13 in particular. It doesn't ask anyone for personal details. If you think a child has given me personal information, email me and I'll delete it.

Keeping and deleting

Leaderboard data stays while you play. Email me from the address below with your friend code (Profile, at the bottom) and I'll delete your player and every score within 30 days. Deleting the app removes the save on the phone; your iCloud copy stays in your iCloud.

Your rights

If you're in the UK or EU you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or object to how it's used. Email me. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

Contact

Dan Horne · hello@danhorne.co.uk

support.title: Help and support
support.html:
Help with Dobie Dash

Email: hello@danhorne.co.uk. Or in the game, Settings → Send feedback. I reply within a couple of days.

### Common questions

How do I play? Tap to jump, tap again in the air to double jump. Eat biscuits, dodge the obstacles, and when a boss chases you, dodge its attacks and jump on its head.

I got a new phone. Where's my progress? It's saved to iCloud. Sign in to the same Apple ID and open the game; it picks up the copy with the most play. For the leaderboards, use League → Keep your place (Sign in with Apple) on the old phone first.

I bought something and it's missing. Wardrobe → Shop → Restore purchases. If that doesn't bring it back, email me the date and what you bought.

I don't want ads. Remove Ads (Shop) stops the ads between runs. Rewarded ads are always your choice.

Someone has a rude name on the leaderboard. Tap ••• next to it and Report name. Once enough people report it, it's hidden until I've checked it.

How do I add a friend? Your friend code is at the bottom of your Profile. Friends add it in League → Friends.

Delete my data. Email me your friend code and I'll delete your player and scores. See the privacy policy: danhorne.co.uk/dobie-dash/privacy
